core.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: nine transparent cutouts for a first-grade English school sports club. One exact square 3×3 production sprite atlas. Equal square cells, strict row-major order, each subject centered in its own cell with at least 13% clear margin on every edge. All nine cells must be occupied and distinct, with no objects crossing cell boundaries. Genuinely transparent alpha background throughout the entire sheet, including margins, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no colored cards, no ground shadow or background panel. Keep each object fully visible and legible at 45 px. Original educational art for age 6: matte gouache on fine paper grain, clean paper-cut silhouettes, warm cream and deep pine green with restrained apricot and persimmon. Large readable forms, charming but calm. No words, letters, numerals, logos, UI, watermarks, decorative scenery, or floating scraps. No existing characters or textbook imagery.
Row 1 left to right: (1) head and shoulders of a light-skinned Chinese six-year-old girl, straight black fringe, pale coral sport T-shirt, no prop; (2) head and shoulders of a dark-brown-skinned six-year-old boy, short dark tight curls, clear light teal-blue sport T-shirt, no prop; (3) head and shoulders of a medium-brown-skinned young reporter with short fluffy curls held by a thin headband, ginger-yellow T-shirt, no prop. Faces front or gently three-quarter, contrasting shirt colors, equal bust scale and pose. 
Row 2 left to right: (4) exactly one white soccer ball with classic black pentagonal patches, no field; (5) exactly one orange basketball with bold curved black seams, no hoop; (6) exactly one red table-tennis paddle with short handle and one tiny ivory-white ping-pong ball beside it with a visible gap, no other equipment. 
Row 3 left to right: (7) exactly one gentle ochre lion, full body and four paws, distinctive rounded dark mane, no lettering; (8) exactly one little slate-and-cream shorthaired cat, full body, triangular ears, whiskers, tail; (9) exactly one blue-gray elephant, full body, recognizable long curved trunk and large ears. Keep animals visually distinct, no clothes or other objects.

Large readable forms, charming but calm. No words, letters, numerals, logos, UI, watermarks, decorative scenery, or floating scraps. No existing characters or textbook imagery.
Design an original peaceful school play court at warm early-morning light. Warm pale cream sky, distant low pine-green trees and simple pale school buildings, lightly textured warm sandstone foreground. Put one small readable soccer net, one small basketball hoop and one teal table-tennis table at far distance along the left/right/top edges. No people, balls, writing, flags, strong stripes, text or dark objects in the central activity area. Fill the wide frame with an opaque illustration.
